 🚨 Crystal Palace-Liverpool: Iraola backs Wirtz and Barcola at Selhurst Park 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Crystal Palace and Liverpool have confirmed their starting line-ups for this afternoon’s clash at Selhurst Park. 
 Both managers have settled the selection questions and named strong starting XIs to battle for three crucial Premier League points.
 OneFootball Videos
 For the Reds, Andoni Iraola adds attacking dynamism by starting Florian Wirtz and Bradley Barcola . Dominik Szoboszlai also keeps his place in midfield after starting in the Champions League, partnering Mac Allister in the engine room.
 Liverpool’s defence will be led by Virgil van Dijk, with Alisson Becker in goal and Jacquet, Kerkez and Araujo completing the back line. Up front, Alexander Isak and Cody Gakpo round out a formidable attack.
 Crystal Palace, meanwhile, will take to the pitch with Dean Henderson in goal and wearing the captain’s armband. Their defence boasts solid names such as Óscar Mingueza, Richards and Disasi.
 The hosts’ midfield will be marshalled by Lerma, Mitchell, Wharton and Timber, with Kamada and Pino linking up with lone striker Jørgen Strand Larsen. Everything is set for kick-off.
